summary: WWE licensed wrestling games span THQ/Yuke's and 2K eras, with older annual releases now dependent on original console discs and offline preservation.

entries.title: WWE '12
entries.definitive_edition: Owned PS3/Xbox 360 disc with patch, DLC, and save state documented

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original HD console build with DLC/title-update state documented

primary.version: Original console disc, preferably with DLC/save state documented
primary.why: WWE '12 was released only for PS3, Xbox 360, and Wii, with PS3/Xbox 360 as the higher-fidelity routes. Current access depends on original discs and preserved DLC/save states because online services and storefront availability are not current.
primary.how_to_play: Use an owned PS3 or Xbox 360 disc on original hardware. Record platform, patch/title update, DLC, roster/unlocks, created content, Road to WrestleMania state, Universe mode, controller, online shutdown effects, and whether the Wii version was compared.

secondary.why: PS3/Xbox 360 are the main archive routes.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: DLC, online, and created-content preservation are version/account dependent.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record unavailable online services and roster/DLC state.
